L'energia e i beni di consumo di base hanno fornito i pochi punti luminosi della sessione, avanzando dell'1,47 e dello 0,75 percento rispettivamente, mentre l'assistenza sanitaria ha guadagnato lo 0,62 percento. I titoli tecnologici sono scesi del 4,48 percento in media, con la tecnologia dell'informazione in calo del 2,32 percento e i settori industriali in declino dell'1,28 percento. I titoli tecnologici e dei semiconduttori hanno subito il peso maggiore della svendita. manual_commentary_html_en:
Technology shares led a broad market decline on August 18, 2026, as rising bond yields pressured equities across the board. According to Reuters, a tech selloff weighed down Wall Street as bond yields climbed, with the WSJ reporting that global government bond yields hit multiyear highs. The broader market reflected this pressure: 286 stocks fell against 229 gainers across the session's 518 tracked issues, with the S&P 500 declining 0.45 percent on average. The Nasdaq-100 underperformed more severely, falling 1.2 percent, while the Dow Jones bucked the trend with a 0.29 percent gain on 19 advances versus 11 declines.

Energy and Consumer Staples provided the session's few bright spots, advancing 1.47 and 0.75 percent respectively, while Health Care gained 0.62 percent. Technology stocks fell 4.48 percent on average, with Information Technology down 2.32 percent and Industrials declining 1.28 percent. Among gainers, Targa Resources rose 7.13 percent without a reported catalyst. Insulet Corporation climbed 5.96 percent following a Financial Times report on an investor lawsuit deadline. Ulta Beauty advanced 4.75 percent, while Intuit, Monster Beverage, Erie Indemnity, GoDaddy, Tyler Technologies, Eli Lilly, and Adobe Inc. all gained between 3.58 and 4.41 percent, though tracked outlets reported no specific catalysts for most of these moves.

Technology and semiconductor stocks bore the brunt of the selloff. Coherent Corp. fell 12.75 percent, Lumentum dropped 9.87 percent, Seagate Technology declined 9.16 percent, and Sandisk fell 9.01 percent. Ciena lost 8.9 percent, Teradyne fell 8.77 percent, and Jabil declined 8.45 percent. Marvell Technology fell 7.82 percent; according to Barron's, Intel and Marvell stocks dropped after chip stocks entered a new bull market. CoreWeave fell 12.1 percent and Corning Inc. declined 7.68 percent, with no reported catalysts for either move.

Fletcher Building Waiting on Meaningful Recovery in NZ Demand
In a Big Pivot, Seat-Back Screens Are Returning at American Airlines

markets_brief.prose_html: Un ampio sell-off obbligazionario ha spinto i costi di finanziamento ai massimi dal 2007, pesando sul sentiment dei mercati mentre i trader rivalutano la dinamica dell'inflazione. L'oro è sceso in mezzo a questo ricalcolo delle aspettative sui tassi, mentre i titoli della difesa hanno attirato l'interesse degli investitori secondo Revolution's Hall. Nel frattempo, i settori ciclici hanno mostrato segnali contrastanti: Fletcher Building rimane cauta sulla ripresa della domanda nel breve termine in Nuova Zelanda, mentre American Airlines si muove per ripristinare gli schermi nei sedili—una scommessa ad alta intensità di capitale sull'esperienza dei passeggeri che segnala un ottimismo selettivo nel settore dei viaggi.
markets_brief.prose_html_en: A broad bond sell-off has pushed borrowing costs to their highest level since 2007, weighing on sentiment across markets as traders reassess inflation dynamics. Gold fell amid this recalibration of rate expectations, while defense stocks drew investor interest according to Revolution's Hall. Meanwhile, cyclical sectors showed mixed signals: Fletcher Building remains cautious on near-term demand recovery in New Zealand, even as American Airlines moves to restore seat-back screens—a capital-intensive bet on passenger experience that signals selective optimism in travel.
